extracted.intended_audience: researchers, institutions, and stakeholders seeking to understand ONR's mission and research priorities (potential applicants for naval research funding)
extracted.subtask_description: A short organizational overview describing ONR's mission, remit, and high-level investment priorities that applicants and collaborators should align with. Emphasizes maritime superiority, delivering technology to the Navy and Marine Corps, and interest areas such as autonomy and AI.

rubrics_metrics.name: Alignment with executive and service science & technology priorities
rubrics_metrics.description: As an executive branch agency within the Department of War, ONR supports the President's budget, and the science and technology priorities of the Chief of Naval Operations, the Commandant of the Marine Corps, and the Secretary of the Navy.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Projects and proposals should align with the President's and senior naval leadership's S&T priorities; alignment with these leadership-directed priorities is a core expectation for ONR-supported work.

rubrics_metrics.name: Contribution to maritime superiority / technological dominance
rubrics_metrics.description: Maritime Superiority Starts Here — The Office of Naval Research is the catalyst of future naval power, ensuring technological dominance for our fleet and force.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Research should enable or accelerate maritime superiority and maintain or increase technological advantage for the fleet and force.

rubrics_metrics.name: Creation and delivery of new capabilities for Sailors and Marines
rubrics_metrics.description: ONR finds the best minds ... sponsoring new research and creating new capabilities for America’s Sailors and Marines.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Emphasis is on research that results in tangible capabilities or capabilities development that directly benefits Sailors and Marines (practical applicability, transition potential).

rubrics_metrics.name: Support for the full technology lifecycle: discover, develop, deliver
rubrics_metrics.description: ONR is tasked with discovering, developing and delivering new technology and capability for the Navy and Marine Corps.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: ONR values activities across the pipeline from basic discovery through development and delivery/transition; proposals that address transition pathways or delivery are consistent with ONR's remit.

rubrics_metrics.name: Relevance to future naval power and national security
rubrics_metrics.description: Established 'to plan, foster, and encourage scientific research in recognition of its paramount importance as related to the maintenance of future naval power, and the preservation of national security.'
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Research should be framed in terms of its relevance to maintaining future naval power and preserving national security; national-security relevance is a principal evaluation dimension.

rubrics_metrics.name: Emphasis on delivering a decisive technological edge
rubrics_metrics.description: Our Sailors and Marines must have the decisive technological edge to ensure they have the advantage in every engagement.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Projects should demonstrate potential to provide a decisive operational advantage; operational impact and superiority outcomes strengthen alignment with ONR goals.

rubrics_metrics.name: Priority investment areas (examples)
rubrics_metrics.description: We will continue to lead the way in fields such as autonomy, artificial intelligence, synthetic biology and more, to ensure America always has the Navy the nation needs.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: While not an exhaustive list, ONR explicitly cites autonomy, AI, and synthetic biology as key areas of interest — proposals in these domains are likely to fit ONR strategic priorities.

rubrics_metrics.name: Preference for high-impact, transformational research
rubrics_metrics.description: ONR’s investments have enabled many firsts, including one of the earliest digital computers and the first programming language; the first satellite navigation system; advanced radar; powerful shipboard lasers; and the electromagnetic railgun.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Historical examples indicate ONR supports research that can produce first-of-kind, transformative technologies; applicants should highlight novelty and potential for significant impact or 'firsts.'

rubrics_metrics.name: Collaboration with top scientific and engineering talent
rubrics_metrics.description: With a workforce that includes some of the top PhDs and engineers in the world in their fields, ONR finds the best minds from across the nation and around the globe...
rubrics_metrics.guidance: ONR engages and expects high-caliber scientific/engineering expertise; strong teams or collaborations with leading researchers are consistent with ONR practice.
